description: New web bounded context: the four Nx libs libs/web/<context>/{feature,ui,data-access,domain} (feature holds containers, ui presentational components, data-access state and API access, domain plain TypeScript), tagged scope:web, context:<context>, type:<layer>, with the Angular selector prefix <context>, the aliases @anvil/web-<context>-<layer> in tsconfig.base.json, and the context in the lint boundary list. Fails if any of the libs exists. Components, services and directives then come from ng-component, ng-service and ng-directive.
